name: What does room addition framing involve?

mainEntity.name: What does room addition framing involve?

acceptedAnswer.text: Room addition framing builds the load-bearing skeleton that supports your new space and ties directly into your existing house. It involves laying the sill plates, assembling exterior and interior wall studs, setting floor joists, installing headers for windows and doors, and erecting roof rafters or trusses. Before any framing begins, you need an approved foundation or subfloor and finalized structural plans. Abraham Becerra coordinates the carpentry crew on-site to ensure wall ties, exterior sheathing, and rough openings match your design before rough trades step in.
acceptedAnswer.description: Room addition framing constructs the structural skeleton—including floor joists, stud walls, headers, and roof trusses—connecting the new expansion directly to your existing home.
